# proxy-shopping-registry

> Trust registry of the public ps-main network of proxy-shopping (a P2P network where a shopper buys for a user, paid in crypto, in shops that take only cash or local payments; an escrow rules disputes). The coordinator 7a0a27bb7092dc59b5bfe195d9f0e0cf81c69373b0d702a41490ed45cfccbe39 delegates (Nostr kind 30500) to the registry operator c1846b34ad9b13d28a602575ed6f762099b7300e0e1e819c585ae49b8c8c3118, which signs the ps-main list (kind 30501) of trusted shopper × escrow combinations. A merged pull request is the approval; CI signs and publishes after every merge.

Use it: trust the coordinator key above (web app: Settings → trusted coordinators; Go node: `trust.coordinators`), network `ps-main`, relays wss://relay.damus.io, wss://nos.lol, wss://relay.primal.net, BTC signet with Esplora https://mempool.space/signet/api (no USDC on ps-main yet). Optionally add the trust bundle https://pad01g.github.io/proxy-shopping-registry/events.json (web app `trust_bundles`, Go node `trust.bundle_urls`) to get the signed events without relying on relays. Every event is verified by the client; the bundle adds no trust of its own.

Join: open a pull request on https://github.com/pad01g/proxy-shopping-registry adding one file.
- Shopper: `shoppers/<name>.json` {"pk", "contact", "description", "regions": cash regions like ["JP-13"], "payments": ["btc-signet"], "escrows": [escrow names]}.
- Escrow: `escrows/<name>.json` {"pk", "contact", "description", "sla_days": 1-365}.
- Operator: `operators/<name>.json` {"pk", "contact", "description", "regions", "list_url"?}; after the merge sign your own list (`psctl list`). `list_url` (optional; one https URL or a list of up to 4, no credentials or fragment, at most 512 characters): where you host your signed bundle `{"events": [your kind 30501 list, the latest 30502/30503/10050 profiles of the shoppers and escrows you list]}` (`psctl list … --bundle-out <file>`); the coordinator's delegation carries one `["list_url", url]` tag per URL, and clients fetch the bundle over HTTPS, so no relay is needed for your list.
- Coordinator directory: `coordinators/<name>.json` {"pk", "contact", "description", "url"?, "bundle"?}. Nobody is made a coordinator: users choose theirs; run your own registry by forking this one.
- `pk` is the Nostr public key, 64 lowercase hex (x-only, not npub): `psctl keys --mnemonic-file <file>` (field nostr_pubkey) or the web app's Settings. `contact` and `description` are required; names are [a-z0-9-]+.
- Revocation: move the file to `revoked/<name>.json` and add "role" and "reason".
Pull requests may only touch coordinators/, operators/, shoppers/, escrows/ and revoked/.

## Files

- [events.json](https://pad01g.github.io/proxy-shopping-registry/events.json): the signed events (trust bundle): `{"network", "version", "coordinator", "operator", "relays", "events": [Nostr events]}`
- [registry.json](https://pad01g.github.io/proxy-shopping-registry/registry.json): the same content, unsigned and readable, with the list entries
- [coordinators.json](https://pad01g.github.io/proxy-shopping-registry/coordinators.json): the directory of coordinators users may choose
- [README](https://github.com/pad01g/proxy-shopping-registry#readme): roles, step by step, revocation
- [Protocol](https://github.com/pad01g/proxy-shopping-go/blob/main/docs/spec.md): spec §2 (delegations and lists), §3 (profiles)
